messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Map/Reduce Matrix Algorithms in Rhipe
parts:
Hello,

Of the bat, nopes. Tonight I hope to write an example of doing
regression using RHIPE, but the issues are

1. Many rows, not too many variables (by variables i also include the
levels of factors) - essentially naive implementation of the LS
regression estimates

one dimensional block cyclic would be somewhat equivalent to row
blocking matrices. But the 'processor' oriented language would
have to be adjusted to the mapreduce flow.

To do block cyclic stuff, you'd want a different input format (which
would have to be wrriten in Java) with specific inputsplits and record
readers
for partitioning the matrix into blocks. And probably a knowledge of
the rack allocation of the blocks.

Hadoop 0.22 has a new scheduler which might much more useful for your needs.
